text:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — RC2 cutoff is in ~3h. There's one PR that may need a hotpatch: `runtime-embeddings` bump to v2.1.2. Small API change but it's causing smoke failures on a subset of model variants. Can we get a cutoff exception?

Miguel Santos: what's failing exactly? CI logs?

Alex Chen: failing at `embed()` integration test: returns length mismatch for long docs. here's failing snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 1536 but got 1024
 at embeddings_test.py:42
```
I traced it: runtime change trimmed padding for 2x quantized models. Code change is one-liner in `kv_cache.c` to fix alignment. No model behavior change.

Jamie Park: sounds risky in headcount. Do we have canary infra to smoke this in prod-reserved lane?

Alex Chen: I can run a canary on ded-qa pool (low traffic). Will run now and post results within 30m.

release-bot: Policy reminder: Freeze exceptions require (1) PR link, (2) QA canary pass, (3) changelog entry, (4) release manager signoff. See <https://redwooddocs.internal/release-policy#exceptions>

Priya Rao: +1 on those. Alex, please also add a short changelog bullet under `unreleased.md` and tag @Miguel for signoff.

Alex Chen: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5823 — will run canary and update changelog. 

(30m later)

Alex Chen: Canary run finished — ded-qa: 5000 requests, no regressions on latencies or correctness for sampled models. Test harness logs: `all checks passed`.

Miguel Santos: ran the quick review; LGTM. No perf regressions in my local perf smoke. Approving exception.

Jamie Park: tagging @release-manager for final go? (pinging in release DM)

Priya Rao: thanks all. Miguel, can you leave a short note in the PR description about the QA steps you ran? We need traceability.

Miguel Santos: done — added list of smoke scenarios + timestamps.

release-bot: Exception approved by Miguel Santos. Merge window reopened for PR #5823. Auto-merge enabled.

Alex Chen: merged and bumped changelog. :tada:

Priya Rao: great — documenting in the RC2 notes. Everyone: if you spot any post-merge issues, ping #eng-oncall.

Jamie Park: :thumbsup:

release-bot: Release cutoff remains at scheduled time. Update: RC2 build will include this hotpatch.
